summary: RELX PLC filed a Form 6-K announcing a non-discretionary share buyback programme to repurchase up to £100 million of its ordinary shares from July 1 to July 21, 2026. This follows the completion of a prior £200 million programme and is part of a total £2.25 billion buyback plan for 2026 announced on February 12, 2026. Shares bought will be held in treasury under the general authority granted at the April 23, 2026 AGM. ABN AMRO Bank N.V. will execute the programme independently. The filing is a routine capital return update; no regulatory premium or structural complexity is present. Watch for continued execution pace in subsequent buyback tranches.
